_about: Hand-picked pictures for Road entries (matched by category + date). These win over the automatic picture check; new entries without a pick keep the automatic check. Fix 16 Oct: picks must be within ~2 days of the event and show the same event; #5, #7, #9, #10 are text only.

picks.entry: Ship 42 has been transported back to the cryo test stand at the Massey outpost for more testing.
picks.author: LabPadre
picks.note: Video of Ship 42 itself arriving at the Massey cryo stand on 9 Oct — the exact event.

picks.author: LabPadre
picks.note: Booster 22 on the Massey cryo stand during its 9–10 Sep cryo test.

picks.entry: Ship 42 heads back to Massey's for further cryo testing.
picks.author: RGVaerialphotos
picks.note: Aerial photo of Ship 42 (with B22) at Massey's, taken 9 Sep — same day it went back for more cryo.

picks.entry: Ship 42 completes two cryo proof tests at Massey's.
picks.author: LabPadre
picks.note: Ship 42's first cryo proof test in progress at Massey's, 3 Sep.

picks.entry: Ship 42's Raptor engines have been removed ahead of Flight 15.
picks.author: LabPadre
picks.note: LabPadre, 30 Sep 18:35 BST: two Raptor 3s (1 RVac, 1 SL) rolled out of Mega Bay 2, removed from Ship 42 — the removal itself, same day. Card date moved to 30 Sep (the event), from 9 Oct (when it was reported).

picks.entry: Both vehicles back to the Mega Bays for Raptor installation.
picks.author: NASASpaceflight
picks.note: NSF, 10 Sep: Ship 42 heading back to the production site for its six Raptors (daylight). Replaces the near-black LabPadre night frame of B22 (2098642467390153040).

picks.author: LabPadre
picks.note: Pad 2 chopsticks being actuated at full speed during maintenance and testing work, 7 Oct.

picks.entry: Pad 2 clear after Flight 14. New servicing structure going in for hold-down clamp work.
picks.author: LabPadre
picks.note: LabPadre, 29 Sep 16:17 BST: the new OLM work platform being lifted into the Pad 2 mount — the servicing structure itself, 1 day before the card.

picks.entry: S42 lifted by Pad 2 chopsticks in a catch position. SQD arm connect tests.
picks.author: RGVaerialphotos
picks.note: Timelapse of Ship 42 held in the Pad 2 chopsticks, 13 Sep.

picks.entry: FAA licence issued for Flight 14 only. F15 needs a modification.
picks.author: NASASpaceflight
picks.note: NSF post announcing the FAA Flight 14 licence on 26 Sep. The image is a graphic, not hardware.

picks.entry: Booster 23 completed a cryo proof test.
picks.author: StarshipGazer
picks.note: Manual (Bernardo): StarshipGazer photo of Booster 23 during its cryo proof test at Massey's, 15 Oct (Texas time; posted 16 Oct 01:24 BST). Flight 16 hardware. StarshipGazer is not a trusted pipeline account.

picks.entry: Pad 2's launch mount work platform removed overnight as Booster 22, reportedly with all engines in, nears static fire rollout.
picks.author: efraser77
picks.note: Backfill 19 Oct (efraser77 not a trusted account at the time). Video (NSF Starbase Live) of the 'Dancefloor 2.0' service structure lifted off the Pad 2 OLM on the evening of 18 Oct (Texas). 'All engines installed' for B22 is from the NSF article of 18 Oct. Picture = the video's own preview image.

picks.entry: Booster 23 rolled back to the production site after its cryo testing at Massey's.
picks.author: TrackingTheSB
picks.note: Manual Flight 16 card (Tusk: no Flight 16 automation). TrackingTheSB photo (NSF Starbase Live) of Booster 23 on HWY 4 heading back to the production site, 18 Oct. Cryo campaign concluded (NSF 18 Oct article; Blobifie: first full cryo done 16 Oct).

picks.entry: Pad 2 after facing 33 Raptor engines, with its new OLM work platform.
picks.author: RGVaerialphotos
picks.note: Context only (never a card's own picture): clear wide aerial of Pad 2's launch mount, used for upcoming Pad 2 entries.

picks.entry: Ship 42's Raptor engines are reportedly being reinstalled.
picks.author: Flight2Starship
picks.note: Approved by Bernardo 23 Oct: picture credit only (Photo · @Flight2Starship, photo Avidspace); the fact stays with the tiered source.

picks.entry: Booster 22 lifted onto the launch mount after pad move.
picks.author: LabPadre
picks.note: Frame at 0:04 of the LabPadre clip: B22 held in the chopsticks above the Pad 2 mount (thumbnail: far view, booster already on the mount).

picks.entry: Booster 22 arrives at the launch site ahead of static fire campaign.
picks.author: Blobifie
picks.note: Frame at 0:51 of the NSF clip: B22 standing at the pad on its transport stand, main camera only (thumbnail: dark multi-cam view of the Megabay). Overlay clock and ticker cropped off.

picks.entry: Ship 42 completed both its single- and six-engine static fire tests at Massey's.
picks.author: SpaceX
picks.note: Frame at 0:13 of the SpaceX video (28 Oct 2026, 16:10 UK): six-engine plume on the Massey stand, vehicle sharp, full height. Picked by Bernardo 31 Oct.

picks.entry: Booster 22 conducted a static fire test on Pad 2.
picks.author: SpaceX
picks.note: Frame at 0:11 of the SpaceX video: B22 33-engine static fire on Pad 2, full plume, tower and booster top in frame. Replaces the NSF-watermarked clip frame (X post media over news-site pictures, 31 Oct).
